notes: OMEA labels this cycle '2027 All-State' (the conference is January 28-30, 2027); it is the 2026-27 school year program and is recorded here as season 2026-27. All All-State applications are submitted through the Acceptd online digital audition platform — there is no in-person live audition for choir. The application timeline dates (March 1, April 2, May 31) are month/day only on OMEA's page; they belong to spring 2026 for the January 2027 conference. Note an internal contradiction on OMEA's Children's Chorus page: it states auditions are open to students who will be in grades 4 or 5 during 2026-2027, and separately that 'only those students who are currently in Grades 3 or 4 are eligible to audition' — both are reproduced verbatim rather than resolved.

organization.name: Ohio Music Education Association
organization.description: OMEA is Ohio's state music education association. It administers All-State Band, Choir, Jazz, Orchestra and Children's Chorus ensembles, which rehearse and perform at the annual OMEA Professional Development Conference, and coordinates regional (Northeast, Northwest, East Central, Southwest) events.

OMEA Professional Development Conference — All-State Ensembles

requirements.title: Grade level and school ensemble membership
requirements.description: Students must be enrolled in grades 9-12 for the 2026-2027 academic year. All applicants must be currently enrolled as members of their school's performing ensemble and must continue that participation during 2026-2027 — All-State Choir applicants must be members of their school choir. Home-schooled students may apply if sponsored by their private teacher, who must be an OMEA member, with a parent/guardian serving as the school administrator. Failure to observe these regulations voids the student's All-State eligibility.

requirements.title: Director must be an OMEA/NAfME member
requirements.description: The application requires the school ensemble director's contact information and their 9-digit NAfME membership number.

requirements.title: 2027 choir recording requirements
requirements.description: Each student records a vocalization (any vocal warm-up exercise of the student's choice) that best demonstrates the extent of their range from bottom to top, then a solo from the OMEA Class 'A' or 'B' list. Solo recordings are strongly recommended to be done with piano accompaniment. Individual vocalists should not submit recordings for multiple parts; strong auditions are considered for different parts as needed.

requirements.title: Online submission via Acceptd
requirements.description: All 2027 All-State auditions are submitted through the Acceptd online digital audition platform. Recordings must be audio-only; accepted formats are MP3, OGG, M4A, WMA, WAV, AAC and FLAC. Each vocalization, etude and movement may be a separate recording. Applicants need student and parent email addresses, the director's contact information and NAfME number, and a credit card for the application fee.

requirements.title: Required regional rehearsal
requirements.description: All-State Choir members are required to attend a regional rehearsal prior to the conference. Dates and locations for the regional rehearsals are included in the acceptance letter.

requirements.title: Housing is the family's responsibility
requirements.description: New as of 2025, OMEA is not responsible for housing All-State participants; lodging responsibility rests with parents/guardians and/or school district officials. Students may stay at their own home with proper releases filed, and are not permitted to house on their own.

fees.description: $20 application fee paid directly to Acceptd for administering the online application process. OMEA does not receive this money and cannot process it.
$225 membership fee due with acceptance forms by September 30 for students selected to an All-State ensemble.

programs.name: OMEA All-State Children's Chorus
programs.description: An elementary honors chorus held as part of the OMEA Professional Development Conference. Selected choristers attend three regional rehearsals plus a full-group rehearsal on the event day, which concludes with a final concert.

All-State Children's Chorus rehearsal and concert
dates.description: Columbus, Ohio, as part of the OMEA Professional Development Conference. A full-group rehearsal runs during the day and the day concludes with a final concert at 5:00 pm.

requirements.title: Grade level
requirements.description: Auditions are open to public, private and home-schooled students who will be in grades 4 or 5 during the 2026-2027 school year and whose teachers are OMEA members; home-schooled students whose parent or private teacher is an OMEA member are also eligible. The same page separately states that 'only those students who are currently in Grades 3 or 4 are eligible to audition.' Applicants should be able to match pitch, access the head voice, and have the focus and stamina for full-day rehearsals.

requirements.title: Recording and application process
requirements.description: The Acceptd profile must be created using the student's name, under program group 'OMEA All-State Children's Chorus'. Recordings must begin with the student announcing their name and grade level, must not be edited or spliced, and must be performed continuously. Soloists perform a cappella. Recordings may be made on digital recorders, smart phones, iPads or tablets. Applications submitted by any other means are not considered.

requirements.title: Three regional rehearsals required
requirements.description: All selected students are required to attend three regional rehearsals prior to the January event; the regional rehearsal schedule and details are included in the acceptance letter and posted to the OMEA website.
